summary:
Implementation plan to fix the avatar movement bug in the Study Goals map and implement new AI-powered study planning features.

Key fixes:
- Refactor `GameQuestMap.tsx` to use derived `currentMilestoneIndex` directly for avatar positioning, ensuring smooth transitions and fixing the "stuck" avatar bug.
- Enhance star visibility in the map nodes.
- Implement a "Study Roadmap Survey" modal to collect user preferences (focus subject, target hours, free time).
- Integrate Gemini API to analyze survey data and suggest optimal study slots.
- Add functionality to sync suggested slots to the calendar.
- Implement "Priority Subject" detection in the AI analysis section.
